description_en: Modifies the configuration of a router interface
description_zh: 调用ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute接口修改路由器接口的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-router-interface-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-interface-id ri-2zeo3xzyf38r4urz0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRouterInterfaceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the router interface.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the router interface
parameters.name: router_interface_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the router interface.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口的名称。

长度为2～128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the router interface. 

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口的描述信息。 

长度为2～256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the peer router interface
parameters.name: opposite_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the peer router
parameters.name: opposite_router_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the router to which the peer router interface belongs. Valid values:

VRouter: vRouter.

VBR (default): Virtual Border Router
parameters.help_zh:
要连接的对端路由器接口所属的路由器类型。取值：

VRouter：路由器。

VBR（默认值）：边界路由器
parameters.name: opposite_router_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the account to which the peer router interface belongs
parameters.help_zh: 对端路由器接口的账号ID。
parameters.name: opposite_interface_owner_id

parameters.help_en:
The source IP address for health checks. The IP address must be an unused IP address in the local VPC.

You can specify this parameter in Express Connect circuit scenarios
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查源IP地址，必须是本端VPC内的一个未被使用的IP地址。

物理专线接入场景下可指定该参数
parameters.name: health_check_source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The destination IP address for health checks. 

This parameter is required if HealthCheckSourceIp is specified
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查目的IP地址。 

指定HealthCheckSourceIp后，该参数为必选
parameters.name: health_check_target_ip

parameters.help_en: The health check threshold. Unit: packets. Recommended value: 8. This parameter specifies the number of probe packets sent during a health check
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查阈值。单位：个。推荐值为8。表示指定健康检查时发送探测报文的个数
parameters.name: hc_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The health check rate. Unit: milliseconds. Recommended value: 2000. This parameter specifies the interval between consecutive probe packets sent during a health check.

In this example, HcThreshold is set to 8 and HcRate is set to 2000. This means that during a health check, a probe packet is sent from HealthCheckSourceIp (the source IP address for health checks) to HealthCheckTargetIp (the destination IP address for health checks) every 2000 milliseconds. If 8 consecutive probe packets receive no response, the health check fails
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查速率。单位：毫秒。推荐值为2000。表示指定健康检查时发送连续探测报文的时间间隔。

本示例HcThreshold设置为8、HcRate设置为2000，即在健康检查时每2000毫秒从HealthCheckSourceIp（健康检查源IP地址）向HealthCheckTargetIp（健康检查目的IP地址）发送一次探测报文，如果连续8次探测报文都无响应，则健康检查失败
parameters.name: hc_rate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the health check IP addresses configured on the router interface. Valid values:

true: Deletes the health check IP addresses.
 
false (default): Does not delete the health check IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除该路由器接口上配置的健康检查IP。取值：

true：删除健康检查IP。
 
false（默认值）：不删除健康检查IP。
parameters.name: delete_health_check_ip
